title: Asset-specific limit order microstructure noise: Parameter estimation and empirical evidence
summary: The one-sided microstructure noise model for high-frequency quotes from a limit order book is generalized to capture asset-specific noise tail behaviour. Estimation of a noise tail parameter becomes the key step for inference. This is possible based on moments of the high-frequency returns when specifying a parametric noise model. For a Gamma noise distribution, we establish a central limit theorem for 1-dependent observations from the resulting Gamma difference distribution and prove that it is valid also in the convolution model with general semimartingale log-price dynamics.
